# Bundled driftmapR source

`driftmapR_0.0.5.9000.tar.gz` is the saved source prototype inspected for this
adapter. The source archive is unchanged; its MIT license and package materials
are included inside it.

SHA-256:
`a18461c14015dbddee5e4e8ca800c6fbf6b152f418a71c233b139c826965b3bb`

`setup_driftmapR.R` checks this hash. The report adapter records the installed
package version and hashes of its description, namespace and compiled R-code
database. The package's separate later validation studies are not resumed,
modified or certified by this project release.
